blurb: Andreas Steno Larsen is a Danish macro strategist and founder of Andreas Steno Research, an independent macro research firm. He previously served as Chief FX & Fixed Income Strategist at Nordea Markets, one of Scandinavia's largest banks. On X he posts global macro analysis with a focus on central bank policy, global liquidity cycles, inflation, and the macro case for crypto assets. He has built a substantial following — likely in the 200–300k range — among macro traders, portfolio managers, and finance-adjacent audiences.
credibility_note: Well-regarded in macro trading circles for liquidity-framework calls and early crypto-macro crossover work. No major public corrections or controversies known, though like most macro forecasters his directional calls carry inherent uncertainty. Runs a paid research service, which is worth noting when evaluating the framing of his public posts.
